# Vendor 3D models

Drop a burger `.glb` here as `burger.glb` and the landing hero picks it up
automatically. Ideally a PBR-textured photoreal model under 8 MB.

Sources:
- Generate one in the admin AR Studio from a burger photo
- Buy a photoreal burger from Sketchfab / CGTrader / TurboSquid
- The Signature Avocado (Khronos PBR) is the fallback

Any file placed here is served publicly at `https://armenu.co.za/vendor/models/burger.glb`.
